response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n_proj FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(n_proj * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(n_proj) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(n_proj - avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE n_proj > avg_n

assumptions.assumption: Only spatial records that match a project (inner join) are counted. Funding sources with no matched spatial records do not appear, so they are not in the cross-source average.

A NULL fundflux is its own group. Each source's ratio is the average of the per-row boxy/boxz. Rows with a NULL boxy or boxz are ignored, and a boxz of 0 is treated as missing to avoid division by zero.
The cross-source average is the plain, unweighted mean of the per-source distinct project counts. The returned ratio is the unweighted mean of the kept sources' average ratios.
